text: A pleasant enough pure vegetarian restaurant serving South Indian cuisine. Had the masala dosa for lunch which came with sambhar and three chutneys. Food service was quick. Having eaten in a number of Sarvana Bhavan restaurants around the world I was disappointed in the flavour of the dosa filling. Though the daar was very good. I also got a sweet lassi which could have been a bit sweeter. Staff are efficient and friendly. There was a buzz about the place with many people in there. I’d visit again if in the area.

One of the more authentic Indian food I’ve had in Berlin. Real spice, real flavors filled with depth. It’s a franchise so they actually got locations globally.

We ordered the thali but found it okay and bit bad in value. I think everyone comes here for the dosas which looked very good as I peeped at our neighbors. At least the thali curries are spicy enough and not bland like in many other Indian places in town. Appreciated the kick.

All in all good service, great all vegetarian menu. Also the mango lassi was just fine not too sweet. Highly recommend for more authentic flavors!!
ownerReply: Thank you so much Jean Du for giving us 5 star rating.

text: Very delicious food, great service and nice ambience. The mysore dosa is so good, I can eat it every day. Very balanced seasoning with the right amount of spices, the chutneys are amazing, especially the tomato one. The sambar is to die for, very delicious and suits the crispy dosa well. The chai is also delicious, creamy but not too sweet. The waiters are quick to respond and friendly. The instrumental Indian music in the background along with a lot of natural lights through the windows make it very relaxing and enjoyable to eat there.

Went to eat idli vada and masala dosa after being in Europe after 2 years I have tasted South Indian food. Super food quality and heavy for myself and a bit spicy too but overall quality is top notch. 1 masala dosa for 14 and idli vada for 10 euros.
ownerReply: Thank you so much Mr Tejas for giving us 5 Star rating.

text: There’s most of the waiting at this place. I like only the South Indian dishes here honestly, rest of them didn’t feel great to me. I go here for the paper roast masala dosa, I feel it’s the closest to what I get back home comparing the size, the crisp and the filling. The filter coffee is good and makes me feel nostalgic. Too crowded on the weekends. No special waiting area and you would need to wait outside in the cold if it’s winter.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Outstanding South Indian Food – Best in Germany!

I had an amazing experience at Saravanaa Bhavan. I tried the Mysore Masala Dosa, Rasam Soup, Ghee Sambar Idly, Masala Dosa, Gulab Jamun, and their Special Madras Coffee—and honestly, every single item was top-class.

The flavors were authentic, rich, and perfectly balanced. The dosas were crispy, the sambar and rasam tasted exactly like traditional South Indian home food, and the ghee idly was incredibly soft and flavorful. The Madras coffee was pure perfection, and the Gulab Jamun was fresh and delicious.

Without exaggeration, this is the best South Indian food I’ve had in the whole of Germany—and I can confidently say it’s even better than many places I’ve eaten in India. Authentic taste, consistent quality, and true South Indian essence.

Highly recommended for anyone who loves real South Indian cuisine. I’ll definitely be coming back again and again! 🙌🇮🇳☕️🥞
The food was delicious, with a wide variety of tiffin options. Vegetarians will especially love this place, as it offers many choices similar to those found in India.

Tasty vegetarian food at reasonable prices. The menu has a lot of variety with South Indian, Indian Chinese and North Indian dishes. Very  conveniently located. The service was quick and liked the ambiance of the place.
ownerReply: Thank you so much Subhasish for giving us 5 star rating.

text: The restaurant is spacious, clean, and offers appreciable service. A bit on the expensive side. However, I wish the food tasted more authentic. I tried some of the mainstream dishes, but they lacked the OG flavor. Perhaps the ingredients are to blame, and I hope they fix this soon.

I visited Saravana Bhavan Berlin multiple times during my business trip for both lunch and dinner, as being a vegetarian this place has always been my go-to. What made my experience even better was the warm and welcoming service by Vipasha.

She is extremely cooperative, humble, and greets customers with genuine politeness. I really appreciated how she took the time to understand my food preferences and ensured I got exactly what I needed. Her attentive and thoughtful approach makes dining here even more enjoyable.

Thank you, Vipasha, for making my visits comfortable and pleasant. Saravana Bhavan is lucky to have such a dedicated team member.
ownerReply: Thank you so much Mr. Arpit for giving us 5 star rating.

text:
We are regulars "HSB" back home and ended up here whilst on holiday.

We had high hopes that it would match the international standard and it was a mixed bag.   The regular fare of Dosa and Idly were on the mark.

The channa Battura and paneer 65 could have done with more flavouring and I guess these are popular with locals and hence not made as spicy? Not sure.

We were seated almost immediately and it was busy but a lively space adds to the ambience.

Service was okay but they missed out on the water we had ordered mid-way but it was fine as we were hungry enough to demolish the food in minutes and be ready to leave.

Overall not as high as we expected but if you stick to the traditional south Indian or the indo-chinese dishes you may get the authentic taste you want.

text: Amazing food! So many options, all vegetarian.  The service is good, everyone is very nice and the waitress helped me make a choice since there are so many options.

text:

This was my 5th trip to this restaurant and I have enjoyed it so much. The staff is very polite and welcoming. You might have to wait 15/20 mins for a table during rush hours , but this place is a must visit
ownerReply: Thank you so much Mr Sean for giving us 5 star rating.

text: All time favorite chain of Restaurants for pure veg Indian food. Specially Berlin one tastes better.

Best South Indian dosas in Berlin,
but go at the right time!

I visited Saravanaa Bhavan Berlin twice in May with my parents. The first time was around 12:30 pm, and we ordered Rava Masala Dosa, Ghee Roast Masala Dosa, and two Filter Coffees. Everything was absolutely delicious. Crispy dosas, flavourful fillings, fresh chutneys, and the coffee was perfect. It felt authentic and reminded us of home.

A week later, we went again in the evening around 7 pm with parents and two friends. Unfortunately, the experience was different. The food felt rushed, the spices were not as balanced, and the chutneys lacked the same freshness. It seemed like the busy evening hours impacted the quality.

My suggestion: visit during less crowded times and stick to South Indian dishes, which are their specialty. The North Indian dishes on the menu don’t carry the same authenticity.

Overall, Saravanaa Bhavan is still one of the better places in Berlin for authentic South Indian food, especially if you go at the right time.

text: I usually love Saravanaa Bhavan and am a regular at the restaurant. But off late, the quality of idlis have gone down. They are hard. Overall, I’m still a fan of the place. Dosas, Curd Vada, Rava Kesari, Puris and filter coffee were great. Tea is a bit too milky for my taste though. Staff are friendly and very gentle.

As someone that isn't a huge fan of Americanized Indian food, my experience was a pleasant one. I enjoyed all of the verity (did I hear they have over 154+ dishes 😲😲😲

Sorry, I have no idea why my Indian friends ordered for us (mix of northern and southern dishes), but I really enjoyed it.

I recommend trying it

Though the ambience is prepared to be excellent, the place is a bit more packed maybe,because it is located in a prime area and also accessible easily from metro station.
Don't expect to get water served free of cost here, unlike in India. You have to buy your drinking water and you are not even expected to bring it along. ( Sorry, I hope may be I am incorrect).
Otherwise, the tasty food is served with warmth by Excellent staff here.

Nice and fast service. Good food. Dosa is quite uncommon in Indian restaurants here, and they have a great selection of Dosa varieties. The Dosa was really good and authentic.
The Mango Lassi is much closer to one you would get in India as it is less milky and has a rich Mango flavour instead.
The coffee was nice too.

The toilets were in mediocre condition though. There was quite some fluid on the ground and the mirrors looked quite old.

Overall a really nice place to eat.

text:
If you’re looking for authentic South Indian vegetarian food in Berlin, Saravanaa Bhavan at Potsdamer Platz is a solid choice. text: This restaurant is fully vegetarian and vegan. They have a big variety of dishes in their menu from different regions in India. I liked the food, it was very tasty and the size pf their portions were good as well. This is a very popular place so make sure you have a reservation before going otherwise you have to wait to find a table but it is definitely worth it. Delicious restaurant!

Finally after years of waiting, Berlin gets its true blue South Indian restaurant. The location is fantastic and the food served is as close as it can get to real South Indian food. Have always been a big fan of their food since ages. Since the initial hype is high, would suggest everyone to be ready for a fair waiting time to be seated. However once inside, the staff are doing their best to cater to all the guests.

Being Indian love Indian food and best place to satisfy your craving. Taste nearly same as in India. Quality and Quantity also good. Waiting time to get table may vary depending on day and time, it took 15 min for me. Food service also took some time due to rush hours.

Lively South Indian restaurant with a unique menu which is located in a business district surrounded by several hotels. It’s also one of the few restaurants which have Somerset cider on tap.

While the service and atmosphere is excellent, the quality of food has deteriorated over the past couple of years. For e.g. the filling of the Mysore Masala dosa was quite bland and it was also partly burnt as seen in the photos. The Idli and Sambar were great.

With that in mind, it’s no longer the best place to enjoy a dosa in Berlin but still offers a wide selection of dishes which can’t be found elsewhere and is still worth experiencing if you live in Berlin.

Food was good but would have been better if it was served hotter than it was , ie temperature wise. I got my dish first and nearly finished before my wife's dish came to the table. If I had waited for her food to arrive my food would have become cold. The samber was warm as it it when it was served.

A restaurant that does not need reviews. Still have to review it, was an experience of being back in India everything that was served it had the exact taste as it would be in India!! If you love South Indian food you should go there!! The owner is very kind and friendly!! Staff is super humble and nice!!

22.09.2021 We went there again after reading the negative reviews. So my verdict reviews seem to be just negative without any reason!!

If a restaurant has reached its maximum capacity then it does take a bit time to get food and that happens in every restaurant on this earth.

text:
Favourite South Indian food restaurant in Berlin!
I ve been there many times and was always super yummy!
I normally order dosa, their specialty; I ve tried normal dosa, mysore dosa and the one stuffed with paneer!

If you are craving South Indian food, then this is a must visit 👌🏻 The food was yummy, made me remember the food in India 🥰 The service was ok, there is a scope of improvement. But overall, the experience was good 😊

Pure Vegetarian and Best Indian restaurant... In Berlin, I tried my first Indian restaurant which was amazing. Vegan and gluten free options are there on the menu.

One can find great dishes here, a good test of south Indian cuisine ( I am Gujarati, so don't know about southern people. whether they like it or not). We ordered Onion uttapam, idali sambhar, masala dosa. ( picture attached)

Panjabi Barbeque option is not there so we ordered chinese starter. Paneer chilly. Nice in taste. I was surprised when i saw a starter served with rice.

We have also ordered North indian dishes. Paneer butter masala, paneer kadai and paneer jafrani with Garlic Naan and Mango lassi. All the curries were good in taste, not spicy but good in taste.

The closest taste to Indian food I have experienced outside of India. The food was fantastic. The service and attitude of the staff was excellent. They guided us kindly and patiently and we chose dishes that we really liked.

Last week, I visited Saravana Bhavan with my office colleagues. I usually don’t post reviews, but this time they truly deserve recognition.

Food:
Everything was excellent. The ghee roast masala, paneer butter masala, and garlic naan were all flavourful and delicious. The pricing is reasonable for the area.

Service:
I met Roshan and Sowmiya. Both had very good knowledge about all the dishes, and they fulfilled all our needs. I genuinely felt the warmth I get back home — that girl had it. Both of them were well-coordinated, and our food and overall experience were top-notch.

Atmosphere:
The place is a little crowded, but you can still have a conversation comfortably.

Last update:
Because of the great experience, we went again this week. This time only Sowmiya was there, so we specifically asked her to take our order. Once again, it was a great experience. We wanted the same combination of staff to look after us, but unfortunately the boy wasn’t there. Thanks to Saravana Bhavan for having staff like this. Now you earned a regular customer ❤️

Tip to guests:
If you need help choosing food, ask these two. They can genuinely improve your experience.

Recommendation:
Ghee roast masala, paneer butter masala, mango lassi, and palak paneer cheese dosa

We are originally from Chennai Tamilnadu - birthplace of Saravanabhavan- and settled in Canada couple of decades back. We came on vacation to Berlin and saw Saravanabhavan. Haunted by nostalgia  and got off from our tour bus without thinking twice to pay a visit and have an awesome dinner, expecting the same quality of food and an excellent service the chain is known for. The place looked awesome and we could see a lot of crowd. We were seated quickly and we were served by one Jagraj. We ordered after some discussion within ourselves one sambar vada plate for starters and Chana bhatura for my partner (she changed her mind from the paneer pulav she initially told Jagraj and he also confirmed having noted the change to Chana bhatura instead of paneer pulao). I ordered an onion/tomato utthappam and we settled down while waiting for our items to arrive. Sambar vada arrived fairly fast. We were waiting on my partner’s Chana bhatura and my utthappam. Shock no.1 - my partner was delivered with paneer pulao which she didn’t want. Nevertheless, sensing that she also created some confusion, she silently accepted and moved on to have paneer pulao without uttering a word to Jagraj. I wouldn’t have done it though! Shock no.2 - we were also silently noticing about 5-10 dosa items were being hurled around to other tables including to the people who came after us to eat, but nowhere in sight of my utthapam. Finally, after about 30 minutes, without pointing out to Jagraj that he had already made a mistake in serving my wife, I asked about my utthappam for which he replied it’s getting ready! I wasn’t in a mood to point out to him his second mistake of the night for having forgotten about my utthapam totally. All I asked him was is to cancel my order for which he unapologetically said he had to check with the kitchen (come on, after 30 minutes, when others around us were served in 5 to 7 minutes). He could’ve honestly told me that sorry he forgot. Instead, he showed his unhappiness about my cancellation. In fact, my partner had already finished eating and ready to go! Then he went around to the kitchen and the till and came around to tell me that my order has been successfully cancelled! Our dinner together was utterly spoiled by an inefficient, forgetful and confused employee and we were forced to rate the restaurant down for it. Please have some coaching in place for the erring employee and other employees too, taking this as a classic example! We will never come back to this Saravanabhavan again.

This is one of the few restaurants where we can find South Indian food. Food is good and the pricing is bit on the higher  side. For someone who had not tried Dosa in 2 years this was refreshing but not fully satisfactory. Manchurian was pretty good. I would definitely visit next time when I am in Berlin.

text: Went to Saravanaa Bhavan Berlin with family for dinner after visit to Spy Museum. Ordered Masala dosa, Onion Rava Masala dosa, mini ghee Sambar Idly , south indian coffee and tea. This place in Potsdamer Platz, Berlin takes me back to India & truly reminds of the authentic South Indian Cuisine. The food here is scrumptious and a treat to your tastebuds. The restaurant comes with a wide spread of both North Indian & South Indian Cuisine. The staff are extremely friendly and you would be awestruck with the quick service. If you are looking for some good Indian vegetarian food your search ends here !!!

Mysore masala dosa, Onion masala dosa were delicious, Authentic Indian! Perfect place for vegans and vegetarians. Keep at least 15 mins waiting time when visiting on weekends as it can get busy. Staff is always nice and welcoming.

Sep takeout order update: ordered south Indian meals in which few items were not fresh & had to be thrown away. Nov takeout order update: ordered biryani but got Pulav which was basically rice with masala, hardly any veggies.

I have been here twice within less than two weeks. After having lived in different parts of India for quite some time, I can highly recommend this amazing place. It's the best pure veg. restaurant in Berlin, which offers a variety of South Indian food, including dosa, idli, and vadha. The falooda was excellent. Be aware that it can be crowded around 8 pm. When my friend and I came here around that time, we waited for approx 20 mins, but the staff was doing an amazing job.

I ordered the Mysore masala dosa, and it was uncooked and pathetic. I immediately called the waiter and asked for a replacement, but he said this was the only option and told me to eat it without taking any action. While I was paying at the counter, the girl who handled the invoicing was super rude when I complained to her. She didn't take any further action. I couldn't eat the dosa and had to leave. If we're being served this kind of food at the restaurant, I think we should boycott it as an Indian restaurant and file a complaint with the German authorities. I'm also experiencing some stomach pain after just two bites.

Food was good! Service was really bad! They don’t have a waiting place! We were standing on the street ! Really missed the Tamil Nadu hospitality! Staffs were not friendly! Overpriced and over hyped !

This Vegetarian Indian restaurant is a recent find near Potsdamer Platz, and given this location, I did expect more I have to admit. It's a big chain with over 100 restaurants worldwide and a decent authentic sounding menu. It's completely vegetarian, so if that is a put off straight away, then read no further. We had a number of dishes, and my main critique here would be the inherent lack of taste. The Masala Tea was very average and the best dish we had by far was the Gobi 65 (cauliflower) and Paneer 65. The rest was very average. Taste is always subjective, so this may be only an opinion on the food front, but the next disappointment was the poor service, which is far more obvious. It was average throughout with a forgotten beer and also allowing us to stay on a table after they packed up the plates and left all the mess there without offering to clean up. In addition, no plates were provided at all, which was a surprise to me as we had to eat without them. There are better Indian restaurants around Berlin. The best being Amrit, so go there if you want authentic, well spiced Indian food and great service. Saravanaa's only real selling points are at least its "fast food" and reasonably priced, so if you want a quick 3* meal, then come here, but truly you can do much better elsewhere for the same price.

The taste was similar to what we get in south India. A bit over priced I would say.
Also when you go there please make up your mind that you’re going to wait there for a while. You better be there as early as possible. Very friendly staffs and service was well managed for the crowd they have.
The filter coffee was so authentic. A must try for coffee lovers.
The chutney was so fresh.
Schezhwan dosa was quite okay as I found it to be a bit salty.
I didn’t find any of the dishes to be spicy but the flavours are not compromised (The taste is adjusted a little bit)
.

Without a doubt: a very good restaurant.
I was a bit anxious that I would miss the meat, but my daughter insisted on that we should eat here. Good that my wife and I listened to her.
Very good dishes, very polite and friendly staff.
And a big surprise for us in the end. A big thank you from the coffee girls parents!
We will  definitely eat here again next time we are in Berlin!
One of my favorite places in Berlin.  Fantastic dosas!  All vegetarian, with plenty of excellent vegan options.

Close to the station so easy access. Place was pretty busy, which may have affected service, but when we got their attention staff were very helpful and accommodating.
The Dosa were huge and very nice with the dipping sauces. The Bhaji was interesting, as it was more like a fried pepper coasted in dosa. Not what I expected but still good.
Was not personally a fan of the coffee, but this was more of my taste, as it had strong bitter notes similar to cinder toffee.
A reasonable price for the amount of food you can get.

Having South Indian food after 1 year, I truly relished my crispy masala dosa and idli treat! The food is authentic, service is good and the menu is extensive with a lot to choose from (including many dosa variations). Waiting period could be long on weekends and a bit taxing in extreme winters. Well trained and polished staff. Will visit again 🤗.

Loved it. Food is really great as usual. The only authentic south Indian restaurant in Berlin. There are lots of dishes to relish. Price is also nominal. Conveniently placed in Potsdamer Platz. It took some time to get the food probably because we went on the first day.

Fantastic as always. My dad is visiting Berlin with me, and we ate here every single day we’ve been here (5 days). Everything on the menu is spectacular and very consistent. Love it here! Will be back constantly while I’m staying here over the next couple of months.
Overpriced, small dishes. Tasty curries but I do not recommend the dosas.

You are welcomed by Indian music and spice smells!
We ordered three dishes
1. Mysore masala dosa: crispy dosa, average potatoes, decent sambar, okay coconut and mint chatni, good tomato chutney. Lacks spices overall, which is what one expects out of a Mysore masala dosa.
2. Poori bhaji: fluffy poori, the bhaji is the same as the dosa filling (which is NOT what we go in India!)
3. Chana bhatura: the biggest disappointment on our order. The bhatura is giant and tasted okay. BUT, the chana is some mish mash of a sweet creamy cashew curry with some chole in it. Nothing compared to what an chole is supposed to be!

Overall far from the Indian experience!

Located at the heart of Berlin in Potsdamer Platz this restaurant offers a good view of the city built in NYC style and a beautiful fusion of international crowd and lofty skyscrapers. The food here is pretty decent and South Indian foods should be your top priority. I would try not to go for North Indian dishes here as they might not match your perception of North Indian food particularly if you are from Northern, Eastern or Western India. But the south Indian dishes like Dhosa Vada Uttapam are just lip-smacking. The masala dhosa I took was almost the size of my entire hand and tasty to the core. The staff is mostly Indian youth keeping the place bright and lively. They have been really cool and kind and hospitable to the core. Loved it and proud of them all. ❤️

Pretty nice taste at this Saravanaa bhavan location. The Rava dosa (Semolina and rice crepe) was very well cooked and perfectly crispy. The sambhar and chutneys served with it were delicious and fresh. The idli (rice cake) was soft and had a great mouthfeel. The wada (lentil fried doughnut) was pretty tasty as well. The place can get crowded during peak mea hours. Recommend this place for a great South Indian meal experience.

The food is great and tasty, many vegetarian options. Delicious Mango Lassi. Authentic filter coffee.
No tap water available, limited Drink options.
Usually crowded,
It's a good restaurant in general. You'll enjoy it here

i never wanted to leave a review as i don't normally do , but few days ago i was sitting with my friends near kitchen when i heard the main owner of this place , yelling at his tamil kitchen staff in tamil, that they should never make or cook anything for service staff ( mostly students ) / like dosa or other food ,  and only give them left over rice or something. which was very disappointing for all 5 of us to hear something like this and from last 2 weeks this is killing me from inside and i had to write ( it was thursday -9:40 pm ) and we had to left from there . me and all my 5 friends and other group will never visit any saravana ever again as they litterly harass staff just for food.
being famous dosa place and not letting your student staff have something they wanna eat. you already save lot on tax for hiring only students
ownerReply:
Dear Bivash Das,
We take allegations regarding staff treatment very seriously. However, the statement made in this review is misleading, exaggerated, and does not reflect who we are as an organization. Saravanaa Bhavan is a global brand with almost 40 years of history, operating across multiple countries with tens of thousands of employees worldwide. In fact, nearly 20% of our workforce today are second-generation employees – sons and daughters of people who have worked with us for decades. This alone speaks volumes about our culture, values, and how our people are treated. It is also important to address your reference to our “main owner.” He is, in fact, the very person who initiated the policy of allowing all staff to eat the same food as our customers. This principle has been part of our culture for many years because we genuinely believe our staff are not just employees, but our business ambassadors and our frontline brand representatives (PROs). We do not tolerate harassment or abuse of staff in any form. Like any large professional kitchen, we do have internal operational policies on food preparation, hygiene, and staff meals, which are meant to ensure food safety, cost control, and fairness across teams. These operational discussions should not be misinterpreted or portrayed as “harassment”. It is also important to clarify that no employee is denied meals. Staff meals are provided as per company policy, and no one is treated differently based on role, background, or student status. Finally, we must also express our genuine confusion about how a customer from Agarpara, West Bengal, was able to accurately interpret a detailed conversation in Tamil well enough to draw such serious conclusions about intent, policy, and internal practices. We regret that you left with this perception, but we strongly reject the narrative that Saravanaa Bhavan exploits or mistreats its employees. Our long-standing employee retention, multi-generational workforce, and global reputation have been built on respect, discipline, and fairness — not on the kind of behavior described here. We remain committed to maintaining a professional, respectful, and ethical workplace for all our team members.Thanks.

text:
Its good
In terms of price and quantity, other Indian restaurants are  better usually

Dosas are on point. Super crispy and tasty. The aloo in masala dosa was yummy. Rava dosa was also good. Idli and vada were good too. Loved the sambar and chutney. We tried vegetable biryani too. But portion size was too small. All dishes are not spicy at all. My non Indian colleagues enjoyed it.
The only thing that wasn't the same as back home were the desserts. We tried Rava kesari bath. It was fair. It wasn't too sweet which is a very good thing. But Falooda was just Ice cream with fruits and syrup. Not the same as back home. But I can't complain since the main dishes were good.
Beware that you've to wait for a very long time for your dishes to arrive. That was a little annoying.

If you want to enjoy dosas, you should try it here. The rest may not be the best.

Pros - The food is really good. Last month i tried the same in Amsterdam and now this one is Berlin is even better. The staff is super friendly and quite cheerful.
Cons - During peak hours like weekends, the service is very slow. My wifes meal came, she ate, the empty plate was even gone and still my food didn't arrive. Then we enquired and my food came then immediately. We ordered a sweet dish which again came after my meal was over, plate taken. So taking away 1 star,

Overall the place, food and the staff is excellent.

Note: Currently they are only allowing Recovered and Vaccinated. No only tested folks are allowed.

I visited this place hoping to enjoy some comforting home style food after a long time but was left disappointed. Conveniently located next to the main railway station, it is easily accessible, though there's usually a queue before entry. The service was slow and a bit disorganized, I requested my coffee to be served after the first dish, but it was brought out first. The food itself was oily and lacked flavor, failing to meet expectations. In the end, I left feeling dissatisfied after paying a hefty price for an underwhelming experience.
ownerReply:
Thank you for the feedback.
We are sorry to hear that recent visit was not upto your expection. We always want to ensure the satisfactions of our guests. We hope we can convince you to came back and visit soon.

text: This place will give you the perfect Indian taste. The quantities are good. It’s one of the best spots if you want to get a taste of Indian palette in Berlin.

I think this is so far the best South Indian(Tamil) restaurant I have been in Berlin. The food is really tasty and authentic. We tried the Medhu vada, Rava Kesari, Ghee Masala Roast and Poori.

The prices are fairly inside budget since I have eaten same food with less quality at higher price in Berlin. The service is really good as well.

It is very near the Postdamer Platz Bahnhof as well.

If you want how food from sothern India taste then this is the place in Berlin.
Expect some waiting in food preparations, though waiting would be well rewarded.

Things to try -
1. different types of dosas
2. Idli
3. Medu wada
4. Filter coffee
5. Indian tea (chai)
6. Dessert - payasam
7. Different types of Rice (Bisibele etc)

And if youre really hungry and want to try different food, go for different types of Thalis. It contains different preparations of different vegetables and rice and poori.

Then there are options of lots of regular Indian food, which is great!!

Firstly, the food was good and filling (what one expects from a Saravana Bhavan).

We had a maligai podi dosa an onion peas uttapam (which I recommend!). The side dishes are a nice, not too hot (spicy) sambar, a surprising tomato chutney, a coconut chutney and a fenugreek-coriander (pudina-dhaniya) chutney (which would've been without the coconut inside it).

The only thing which I felt could've been better is that they could've asked us when we wanted our beverages (they gave them before the meal; we would've preferred later). But it's a decent place with seemingly good food!

Must visit for a South Indian. Dosa and variety of dosas available. Honestly I liked dosas, idli , poori kurma, filter coffee.
Rice items like bisibelebath , Gobi Manchurian were not at all good in taste.. I was craving for Indian food, Indian Chinese food 😅 but was not satisfied. Falooda was also disappointing tastewise.
For Dosas, idli, poori,  Filter Coffee you should definitely visit!! Quantity and Quality is no doubt very good 👍

Went on time for lunch on a Sunday, got a table immediately and service was quick. Food came in around 15 minutes and service people were really nice. The restaurant is still new so they are ironing out issues. Saw a longer queue when I left.

If you're not sure what to order, get the dosas (masala dosa if you like potatoes), can't go wrong with it. If you don't like eating with hands, try idly / vada - they are friendly to eat with cutlery.

Friendly staff, but the food was cold.
I've had Palak Paneer in a few other Indian restaurants before, and unfortunately this one wasn't good enough; kinda tasteless.
The best part was Paneer Naan.
Mango Lassi was just ok when compared to Amrit on the other side of the street.

What should I say ? This is just "that" place to go for delicious vegetarian Indian cuisine.

This place has a lot of dishes and man their are woohoo.

It is well visited and you should not expect a quiet place. But if you are up for real good food in and nice atmosphere, then you are just right.

And hey, give the service some credits for serving so many people and still keeping a friendly manner.

Sometimes you miss a desi touch to your food palette and that is why Saravana Bhavan exists.

Visited the place today only to go back home happy that both our tummies & hearts were full.

We ordered the following & here is the review

1. Special Madras Coffee: Aced it but the sugar was slightly on the higher side. If you are not someone who likes the coffee with sugar please make sure your mention it.

2. Rava Masala Dosa: Nailed it. The dosa was perfectly crisp and paired really well with the chutneys (dips) it came with.

3. Butter Naan: Again tasted perfect.

4. Paneer Butter Masala & Paneer Gobi Fry: the dishes tasted good but the only caveat being that it came with a portion of rice. (This is a norm in Berlin and we should have noted this before. Not the restaurants fault at all. If you are visiting the place, it’s best to keep this in your mind)

The restaurant offered us takeaway boxes to help us pack the rice ourselves though.

Overall, brilliant place to visit if you want to treat your taste buds to some Indian spice.

The menu is all vegetarian and the restaurant doesn’t accept reservations on weekends. So please be prepared for a short wait before the staff can get you table.

One of best places to have Indian food.
Best for South Indian dishes and one of best mango lassi i had in Germany.

In pictures you will see Masala Dosa, Mysore Masala Dose and Chole Battura with Mango lassi.

Recommend: Any South Indian dish and Mango lassi.
For Indians leaving away from home and wanted to have some Indian food, specially recommended to have it.

This chain of restaurant is famous for serving authentic south Indian cuisine. We went with lot of expectations as we didn't had good south Indian food recently, and this place didn't disappoint us. We tried Rava marsala dosa, uttapam, coffee etc. And everything was awesome. Next time we have to try out other items.

Food -
Ordered filter coffee, which was really amazing like always.
Then ordered Mini Idly with Ghee (33 from menu), it tasted good too. It came with two idli, one medu wada and chutneys.
Then ordered one Thali - Sarvana Special Meals (156 from menu) - Lovvveed it. It was really yummy, came with many different sabjis, 2 Bhatore or puri, one papad, plate full of rice and one plate was too much for one person.
And then, I had been wanting to eat Payasam since a very long time and Ate daal payasam made from Jaggery. It was really too sweet, but my quota for eating sweets is over for this week because of this payasam.

Service - Quick and the orders also came within 5min.

Crowd - Ya, it was crowded. I think on weekend, you have to reserve a place, because weekdays was really full too.

Cleanliness - Very much.

Loved the place, will surely visit again. 😊

We had a masala dosa with filter coffee , chole bhature with lassi. Dosa was pretty nice you can ask for sambhar and chutney again. But chole bhature seems not like chole bhature 😅. As you see the gravy is light yellow with lot of coconut it was nice in taste I would say but not the chole we have with bhature. My husband liked the filter coffee it was strong. Over all experience  was nice You can try once.

Most delicious and authentic indian food ever outside of India- they have maintained their high quality and great taste. We had the sada dosa and Mysore masala dosa and both were pure gems. They are usually always full, so be prepared to wait to be seated, but it will absolutely be worth the wait. If you like authentic south Indian food it doesn't get any better than this!

Very authentic South Indian vegetarian restaurant in Berlin.
The taste was really good and authentic.
You will get the special south indian filter coffee here. A must visit place to tey authentic South Indian food.
The portion size comparatively very small.
You ll not feel full with only one dish for one person, which is usually the case in other Indian restaurants.
Expensive as compared to other Indian restaurants in Berlin.
One star less because of super congested sitting arrangement. From the German standard sitting arrangement is way below standard.
Very good vegetarian Indian food (south India style) at fair prices, fast service, big place with tables inside and outside. Huge variety of Dosas and many other dishes. Recommended!

The waiting line was long
We went on a holiday during lunch hour so we had to wait around 10-15 mins outside cuz it was full
After that the menue came very quick
Even though it was full they were fast and friendly
They have the most variety of options, am sure more than 300 selections and all vegetarian so you will definitely find something
Even though I am not vegetarian i did enjoy my meal so much. And the tea and milk i ordered is good
They served us fast less than 10 minutes after we ordered which was impressive
If u like spicy food and indian food then this is the place to go
All indian food no other options
The prices are decent

Definitely recommend ;)

Haven't been to Sarvana Bhavana in 4 years after coming to the US. I'm visiting Berlin for my winter vacation and was absolutely thrilled to see Sarvana Bhavan. I definitely had to try their food. Overall, food was very decent. Loved it!

Would highly recommend dosas from here. 😊
The ambience is lovely, though the prices feel a bit steep. The food was decent , nothing to rave about. Sadly, the quality and portion sizes have declined over time.

We went on a Monday noon for lunch and it wasn’t very crowded. Got seated immediately but none came to take order. Luckily, we scanned the QR code placed on the table and ordered. Dishes got delivered in less than 10 minutes. We planned to have meals but Dosa was very tempting. Ended up having Ghee Masala Dosa and Medu Vada. Same taste as in India. Authentic and delicious. Staffs were kind. I could give 5 stars but due to the delay in taking order despite no crowd, im giving 4 stars.

Having been to multiple Saravanaa Bhavan restaurants across the world, I always know what I am about to get. This branch did not disappoint. The restaurant is spacious with high ceilings and has a relaxed atmosphere. We called for Idlis, Mini Ghee Sambhar Idly, Dahi Vada, Plain Dosa, Rava Dosa and Filter coffee. The sambhar and coconut chutney were delicious! The service was quick. Will recommend for a easy South Indian meal.

Ordered:
Ghee Pongal
Bier
Onion and peas uthapam
Kaima idli.
Compliment:
Coffee

I felt the same taste as South Indian food, kaima Idli is superb it's the same called chilli Idli. Ghee Pongal is also good. Onion and peas uthapam is nice, felt the taste of South Indian. More of Karnataka taste.
PS: thanks for the compliment coffee, can be served with sugar next time :) ofcourse i asked for it and they were so nice to give it faster.

My suggestions would be for the washrooms can be a little bit of hygiene, it's not bad but still can be well maintained hourly as i felt the place is crowded easily.

Would definitely a place to go when in Berlin, the atmosphere is nice, place is situated centrally. Easily accessible.

This is my second time. First time we ordered food and picked up. The place is crowded. But we didn't wait for long time to sit down. Staff was nice. And the most important thing, food was delicious. Loved it.
Very delicious and authentic Indian cuisine in a very nice location!
ownerReply: Thank you so much Zuzia for giving us 5 star rating.

text:
A must-visit in Berlin for the Desi-at-heart.

(+) located excellently at the Potsdamer Platz, with great connectivity.
(+) lively surroundings.
(+) beautiful, modern exteriors and interiors; infact, one of the best interiors for a Saravanaa Bhavan.
(+) the staff is mostly a younger team than other branches.

(-) food quality is below-average and diluted.
(-) completely unworthy of the money spent.
(-) quite long waiting times, without any arrangements for the people waiting outside.
(-) the staff is disinterested and indifferent to the customers already seated inside.
(-) seating arrangement is cramped.
(-) toilet/restroom condition is poor and utterly unhygienic.

Dosa (paper roast) is a must. As was the Bonda/Vada Sambar. Even the filter (Madras) coffee is served properly in steel cups.  Also the chutneys were delicious. Don't worry, you can ask for  a second round. The decoration is nice, the restaurant just has a weird layout around the corner. All in all: The food makes you happy 😊. Will return for the poori and idli (we could not stuff more food into our stomach, but it looked good on other people's plates)

Enjoyed the experience.    A waiter that spoke  hardly English, a lengthy menu with 323 items not counting the drinks and  without any clear explanation, all sort of Indian traditional  dishes turned vegetarian. We could only expect a lot of surprises.
The service was a bit chaotic but quick with waiters asking us again and again what we wanted to order but it was all in good spirit and we even had a taste of a dessert -Rava kesari before ordering something else.
We ordered the North Indian Tali which was basically some round dough with all sort of dipping,  some salty, some sharp and even a sweet  one. Enjoyed the  richness of all the taste and I  though it was  an interesting dish. We also had Noodle with mushroom which was also good but less special. I  though it strange to have it with ketchup on the plate which is probably not a traditional Indian sauce.
For drinks we add mango Lassi which was good
For dessert we had a Falooda. Even the waiter did  not know what it was which is not a surprise with 323 items! Anyway, it had ice cream, not exactly sure which flavors, red tapioca, green tapioca and red pasta at the bottom. Not sure what to make out of this but certainly an culinary surprise.
Not the top of the culinary world but a  great fun evening with some new food combinations to remember. Not expensive and worth the visit.

Best South Indian food 😎 food was so delicious and the staff was amazingly nice friendly and cheerful 😃 They take their customers with full care and attention. Food was served right on time means no delay in serving! Fully vegetarian menu, so no worries for the non vegetarian, feel free to order whatever you want 😊 Best for Muslims who take care of Halal food 😍More, this Resturant is on a very good location, means on 1min walk from buses of Berlin M48,M85 terminal and S-Bahn station!
Resturant atmosphere is very good and you can find the chain of this Resturant around the world in different countries. If you are in Frankfurt, you have this there too 😊
Have fun and enjoy the taste of south India wherever you are 😃

Great location and food was great with the authentic Saravanan Bhavan touch on it. Service and order management need to be improved but it’s too short time to rate on it. We hope they will give their best in coming days. Highly recommended 😃😃

South Indian food is great. Try the ghee roast masala dosa. Filter coffee is good too.

Edit: Recently noticed that prices have increased by quite a bit so now it seems a little on the expensive side.
ownerReply: Thank you for your positive rating, Varun! We are happy you enjoed your dining with us. Hope to see you around again!

text:
Ambience is quite good, location is also very central. But they need to improve on service. It seems they have employed a lot of part time students from University and they are just doing service for money. Barring one or two good people, rest are mostly lost and doing formality of serving. A chaos.
We visited on 10th June afternoon. Sat on table 54, my small kid was very hungry and we requested if one plain dosa can be prioritized, he said yes and later brought all our dosas at first. When asked why is plain dosa still not there? He was clueless, sent his fellow, and the lady was like there is no way to prioritize any order. And then she just disappeared. We asked for order cancellation because it did not come on time. Both these attendants never came back.
Food was good, you will be satisfied overall. Dosa sizes are decent and sufficient for one person. 3 stars until they improve on service.

One of the best veggie Indian food we’ve ever had.
The staff were so friendly and cool, giving very good recommendations for us.

I am writing a review to make people understand, the reviews here may be manipulated. One of my friend wrote a bad review and that was deleted by him after some time. When I asked him why it was deleted. He told me that they issued a notice of defamation for the bad review. Out of fear he deleted the review. I'm here to warn people that dont trust restaurant based on Google review or any other review, these are manipulated by making people fear of defamation. I'm fine if they send defamation against me.

Always very tasty food and very friendly staff. 💯
Would recommend Gobi 65 and Masala Dosa for sure. Also Tea or Filter coffee is really good 🤘🏼
Tip: Please make a reservation before going if you are planning to go in the evening over the weekend. Its a busy place always.

Delicious food, great atmosphere and amazing location... We tried Ghee roast dosa, Mysore masala Dosa and sarvana Bhavan special Thali - all 3 were good and the portions were enough.. Ghee roast was one of the best and I strongly recommend it..

This is one of my go-to places whenever I feel like eating Indian food in Berlin. The food is usually great and as it's a purely vegetarian place, there are a lot more options for vegetarians than the usual Indian restaurants. Usually Indian restaurants have about 20 vegetarian/vegan food options in the entire menu, but here there are over 200 options, which is amazing if you are a vegetarian.

You must try the following at least once here,
1. Ghee roast masala dosa & Ghee Rava onion masala dosa
2. Madras special coffee
3. Chole bhature
4. Saravana Bhavan special meals (South Indian)

We have also tried starters such as Gobi 65 (Dry) which was pretty good and Chilly Gobi Manchurian which was pretty bad.

The above options are usually really good, and you can select any South Indian food item on the menu and you can be sure it's as close as it can get to authentic South Indian cuisine.

The service does tend to be lousy when there're a lot of customers, but that's something that can't be helped.

Do keep this in mind though, the place is usually very busy and the seating space is confined. So if you are looking for a cozy place to have lunch/dinner peacefully, don't choose this restaurant.

Best South Indian restaurant in the town with huge variety of dosas and other vegetarian Indian food. One thing that can be improved is the quantity of sambhar.
Only thing lacking is good vegan options in hot beverages.

Update: service start taking some
Slump with delayed orders or missing food items

Felt amazing to have authentic south Indian food after a long time. The Ghee roast and filter coffee I tried was delicious. Service was a bit slow and the place was a little crowded. You can have a really good meal for around 15-18€.
It was my first time eating in this restaurant and totally in love with the food, I wish they open a restaurant in warsaw also. Super delicious food, highly recommend👍🏻

The Berlin SB was awesome. Service was great ...Vipasha and others there were good. Met Shivakumar, the owner, there....got a photo with him. I first visited SB in KK Nagar, Chennai, in 1981. Eating at a SB after a long time.
ownerReply: Thank you so much Mr Vijay for giving us 5 star rating.

text: Went to eat brunch here two weeks ago, it was Saturday so it was quite full. The team took our name and we waited outside to be placed at a table, took around 5 minutes, so completely acceptable. Unfortunately the table was rather uncomfortable, next to a heater and very tight. Not at all comfortable for two people. We started with Medu Vada sambar and idli and were planning to try more of the menu later. Saravanaa Bhavan has a great reputation, but after visiting I don’t understand why. Medu Vada was too hard, it’s difficult to understand how they here in their big kitchen with loads of staff and equipment can’t at least come a little bit close to what Mumbai street food stalls manage to cook. The Sambar taste was authentic at least. Big highlight was the plates. My excitement for the food was decreased rapidly when I saw the plates were not washed and wiped properly. You can see it in the photos, with just a finger the layer was coming off. Felt very gross afterwards. The staff is VERY busy got the feeling of Mumbai 😅 like they are just waiting for you to finish your food fast so they can give the table to the next customer. I feel more relaxed on a McDonald’s to be honest. Worst part was the toilet. I have never seen so small stalls in my life. Not possible to use without touching your knees to the door while using. And super dirty too unfortunately. It was such a shame because I was looking forward to this visit for a while. We went to a different restaurant afterwards because we were still hungry of course. There is much better places, I would not recommend you to go to Saravanaa Bhavan.

Comforting and authentic South Indian staples. The dosas are very tasty. Super recommend the ghee onion rava dosa. The only reason not to give the place 5 stars is because the food is not as delicious as it is in the Saravana Bhavan restaurants in Chennai, India. Rated the atmosphere 3 stars because it's odd to listen to old instrumental bollywood songs at a Chennai based Saravana Bhavan.
This place is always full so expect to be noisy. However, you can’t get better dosas. Authentic Indian place where to enjoy tasty food.

Had lunch and dinner here on the day of the Berlin half marathon. Both meals were great, we got masala Dosas and idlis. Both the staff who served us were prompt and attentive. We were just a uncomfortable at our table because it was near the door and we were getting cold air every time someone walked in. We requested one of the make staff to move us and he just said something in German and never made eye contact with us again that evening 👀 Anyway, the food made up for it. Great job!
A nice environment, comfortable to be there. A lot of dishes to choose from. The most dishes cost 12-20 euros. Recommend dosas and mango Lassi)
ownerReply:
Thank you so much
 ' ' Ms".Turysheva for your feedback and We await for your upcoming visits to do much better service with tasty foods.
Turysheva for feedback

text: Amazing dosa, can be a bit of a wait if it’s crowded, service okay ✅ friendly but not that fast (again crowded). But food is great, I recommend rava masala dosa and onion uttapam
We have tried Saravana Bhavan in a couple of cities in Europe. But i think the best of the lot is the Berlin one! The dosa, sambar, chutney and coffee are so close to home.

From what I heard, their Indian food is better than their Chinese one. So I tried the doas and it was very delicious! Great spices.
The weekly changing appetizer as well. Very delicious.

• Service (2/5): A dessert I ordered seemed forgotten. When I asked for the bill and requested to cancel it, the dessert was brought immediately afterward and the cancellation wasn’t acknowledged.
• Payment/Receipt: Told the card machine wasn’t working and asked to pay cash; we were not given a printed receipt at payment so we took a screenshot instead.
• Food (2/5): I think it was below average; portions felt small for the price. We ordered items including Paneer Korma (€13.25) and Vegetable Butter Masala (€12.50).

Forget all the restaurants in Berlin that Claim to make south Indian speciality food. Come here. If you want to experience real south India delicacies, this is where you'll get that. Yes, it's always crowded & it's hard to get a seat but, that's all for good reason. The only thing that wasn't good was the manchurian. But otherwise the south Indian delicacies make up for everything else. All the coconut chutnies & dosas available everywhere else are sorry excuses.

Most authentic south Indian restaurant in Germany and arguably in all of Europe.
Definitely try the dosas if you are visiting. Expect waiting time over weekends of Upto 30 mins as it is an original restaurant chain from India.

This place is always bustling. A solid choice for South Indian basics. Probably the best sambar and chutney in town.
Also an excellent thali.
Some of the Chinese and North Indian mains can get a bit oily, and salty, but surely that is the point.
The service is ok, and the bathrooms can be kind of scary, but the prices are ok given the quantity of food, and the really consistent quality.
